A work permit must be issued, 
the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,

Wear your safety helmet, 
 safety shoes, eye glass, nose mouth "dust cover" .... etc

Wear Anti static hand probe to avoid electrical 
 choke
Unit must be shutdown.
Digital multi-meter
Digital multi-meter
Hand held radio wave for communication
Screw driver, Nut driver, and isolating tape
Antistatic vacuum cleaner for dust cleaning
Antistatic vacuum cleaner for dust cleaning
Review technical reference material and manufactures manual.
Open DPU cabinet.
Using cabinet termination identify the location for the desired QBO card.

Using cabinet termination list for each card identify the three I/P wires for 
 the 1st channel.
Using the screw driver to remove these two wires and isolate with tape.
Connect the voltmeter leads to the 1st channel.

Using radio from CCR make forced 1=on for this point according to the 
 termination list.
Watch the voltmeter reading to see the contact closed or opened.
If the reading is OK, repeat steps 1 to 5 for the another 15 channels.
If any reading for any channel in CCR not correct replace the card.
Remove the voltmeter leads.
Reconnect the O/P wires to terminal strip.
Close the cabinet.
Place a copy of test result in the field maintenance file.

Introduction
This document 
outlines the routine testing procedures P1, which must performed on an 
annually bases as 
indicated by Y1 in the title block.
The DCS QBO 
Digital output card have 16 channel output to indicate alarm lamp on operator 
disk on MIMIC
The first draft initiated by eng:

Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued, 
the qualified maintenance staff should
 carry the suitable safety category,
Wear your safety helmet, 
 safety shoes, eye glass, nose mouth "dust cover" .... etc
Wear Anti static hand probe to avoid electrical 
 choke
Unit must be shutdown.
Tools and Equipment
Digital multi-meter
Digital multi-meter
Hand held radio wave for communication
Screw driver, Nut driver, and isolating tape
Antistatic vacuum cleaner for dust cleaning
Antistatic vacuum cleaner for dust cleaning
Work to be Carried Out
Steps to Prepare for Test
Review technical reference material and manufactures manual.
Open DPU cabinet.
Using cabinet termination identify the location for the desired QBO card.
Start Test
Using cabinet termination list for each card identify the three I/P wires for 
 the 1st channel.
Using the screw driver to remove these two wires and isolate with tape.
Connect the voltmeter leads to the 1st channel.
Using radio from CCR make forced 1=on for this point according to the 
 termination list.
Watch the voltmeter reading to see the contact closed or opened.
If the reading is OK, repeat steps 1 to 5 for the another 15 channels.
If any reading for any channel in CCR not correct replace the card.
Return Card to Service
Remove the voltmeter leads.
Reconnect the O/P wires to terminal strip.
Close the cabinet.
Place a copy of test result in the field maintenance file.
